description: Kinds: linked ledgers of kinds of things (instruments, woods, alloys, elements). Kinds of things in one shared shape, linked to what they are made from: 2,392 musical instruments (Hornbostel-Sachs class, origin country), 504 woods, 285 alloys, 174 chemical elements and the materials instruments use. Follow made_from chains (guitar -> wood -> ...; cymbal -> bronze -> copper and tin). Japanese names where they exist. Source Wikidata (CC0). Routes: /{id}; /chain (id*); /facets; /search (facet, q, limit, offset). Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /{id}, /chain, /facets, /search. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
